rows.definition: select record_id, quantity, unit_price, amount, event_ts from raw_accepted where source_id = 'src-orders'
select record_id, quantity, unit_price, amount, event_ts, channel from raw_accepted where source_id = 'src-payments'
select record_id, quantity, unit_price, amount, event_ts from raw_accepted where source_id = 'src-refunds'
select record_id, quantity, unit_price, amount, event_ts from raw_accepted where source_id = 'src-shipments'
select record_id, quantity, unit_price, amount, event_ts from raw_accepted where source_id = 'src-inventory'
select record_id, quantity, unit_price, amount, event_ts from raw_accepted where source_id = 'src-web-events'
select o.record_id, o.amount, p.amount as paid, w.quantity as sessions from stg_orders o left join stg_payments p on p.event_ts >= o.event_ts left join stg_web_events w on w.event_ts <= o.event_ts
rows.grain: one row per order and payment

rows.definition: select r.record_id, r.amount, o.amount as order_amount from stg_refunds r left join stg_orders o on o.event_ts <= r.event_ts
select s.record_id, s.event_ts, o.event_ts as ordered_at from stg_shipments s left join stg_orders o on o.event_ts <= s.event_ts
select date(event_ts) as day, record_id, amount from int_orders_paid union all select date(event_ts), record_id, amount from int_refunds_netted
rows.grain: one row per record_id and UTC day

rows.definition: select date(event_ts) as day, count(*) as shipments, sum(amount) as fees from int_fulfilment_lag group by 1
select date(event_ts) as day, sum(quantity) as units, sum(amount) as value from stg_inventory group by 1
